The Blackpool show has become synonymous with big staging and unforgettable routines
From Halloween high kicks to magical Movie Week moves, Strictly Come Dancing's highlights can often come thick and fast, but once a season, there is a particular peculiarity that has become a much-loved tradition - the annual decamp to Blackpool.
The seaside resort was a location in the first series of the BBC programme back in 2004 and went on to become a mainstay moment.
The show returns to the town on Saturday and will see eight couples taking to the dancefloor in the magnificent Blackpool Tower Ballroom.
But how did Blackpool become such a Strictly highlight and what does it mean to the town?
Blackpool Tower Ballroom sits underneath its most famous landmark
The show is usually made at the Elstree studios in Hertfordshire, but for one week each year, it goes north to the Tower Ballroom in Blackpool.
The ballroom regularly hosts World and all-England dance championships, and the Blackpool Junior Dance Festival has been held there every year since 1964.
As such, many of Strictly's dancers already know the venue well from their earlier careers.
Speaking in 2023, Lauren Oakley said she was seven when she first took to the dancefloor there.
"I just got my first dance partner and I remember being taken aback by how amazing it was and how dancers from all over the world were there performing and competing," she said.
Strictly's visit to the resort has become a firm favourite with fans of the show
It is little wonder that the dancers find it such an awesome venue.
The famous ballroom dates back to 1894 and is made from about 30,600 pieces of oak, mahogany and walnut wood.
The dancefloor is also sprung, which means it is supported underneath by wooden strips or foam, making it slightly bouncy.
It is also enormous, measuring about 121ft by 101ft (37m by 31m), which makes it about nine times bigger than the one at Elstree.
The cast of Strictly 2017 opened Blackpool with a dance to Let Me Entertain You
The ballroom regularly hosted Strictly's predecessor Come Dancing during that programme's almost 50-year run.
That made it a prime candidate for a visit when that show was upgraded and rebooted into Strictly Come Dancing in 2004.
Sure enough, the third episode of that first series came from the Tower Ballroom, with the dancefloor then hosting the final the following year.
Blackpool Week became a regular thing on the show from 2009, when Children In Need temporarily took over the Strictly studio at the old BBC Television Centre every November.
Since 2013, only the Covid pandemic has stopped the programme decamping to the seaside resort for an episode.
The sheer size of the Tower Ballroom means the dancers often go large in Blackpool Week in terms of both routines and staging.
Few Strictly fans will forget the splendour of Emma Barton and Anton Du Beke's American Smooth to Let's Face the Music and Dance in 2019, a routine which earned the now-Strictly judge his first 10s and highest ever score on the show.
Equally memorable from the same show was eventual winner Kelvin Fletcher's Jive with partner Oti Mabuse to Jailhouse Rock, which lived as long in the memory for Fletcher's impressive quiff as it did for their near-perfect performance.
Ed Balls produced many memorable performances, not least of which came in Blackpool
Blackpool was also the venue for another utterly unforgettable Jive, performed in 2016 by Ed Balls and his partner Katya Jones.
It featured the former politician being held aloft by Jones and four of her fellow dancers and throwing himself wholeheartedly into the dance in front of flames and a piano backdrop, all to the sounds of Great Balls of Fire.
Blackpool performances are often a case of go big or go home
Other Blackpool highlights include Jamie Borthwick being lowered to the dancefloor on a giant sparkly ketchup bottle in 2024, Fleur East and Vito Coppola getting straight 10s for their amazing Couple's Choice in 2022, Ashley Roberts and Pasha Kovalev's fish and chip shop-based Jive in 2018 and Frankie Bridge and Kevin Clifton's matching haircuts and thrilling Quickstep in 2014.
Ann Widdecombe and Anton du Beke perform a Samba in Strictly Come Dancing
But no highlights reel from Blackpool would be complete without a mention of the late Ann Widdecombe's Samba with Anton Du Beke in 2010.
Staged to Heaven Must Be Missing An Angel in canary yellow outfits, the routine saw Du Beke swing the politician round by her arms and legs.
While it may have been a miss with the judges - the combined total of 13 included a one from Craig Revel Harwood - it was a huge hit with viewers, who saved the couple in the public vote.
The majority of the professional dancers have a long history with Blackpool Tower Ballroom, having danced their competitively in their pre-Strictly careers.
Speaking in 2024, Katya Jones said "if you could describe Blackpool week in one word or phrase... it would be like coming home".
"The hall is bigger, so you have to really fill that space with your performance, with energy and spark, which sort of comes quite naturally because it's an epic room to be dancing in."
Sarah Hadland and Vito Coppola performed a Couple's Choice in Blackpool in 2024
Fellow pro Vito Coppola said it was a combination of history with the venue and the splendour of Strictly that made the trip special.
"I love Blackpool. I won the Blackpool Tower competition in 2008 when I was 15," he said.
"Every time I'm in Blackpool, I can feel the energy of years and years of dancing and all the big legends that have danced there.
"Words cannot describe how amazing the feeling of dancing on the ballroom in Blackpool is.
"Every week is beautiful and different, but Blackpool is just Blackpool."
Dazzling routines, outrageous sets, flamboyant costumes and the occasional dance dis-aaa-ster.
Like Vito, Nikita Kuzmin is a huge Blackpool fan, but for him, it is not just about the joy of dancing, but also the resort's more-varied delights.
Speaking on Strictly Come Dancing: It Takes Two on Tuesday , he said he loved getting a chance to enjoy Blackpool's amusements.
"I've said it a million times... it's the best arcades in the world," he said.
Johannes Radebe was one of the only dancers who had not performed in Blackpool before Strictly
But not all the professionals have such a long history of visiting the town.
For some, like dancer-turned-presenter Johannes Radebe, it was Strictly that made the Blackpool dream come true.
"It's always special to dance at Blackpool and Strictly gave me the opportunity [as] when I was competing, we couldn't afford to travel to the UK."
"Everyone wants to get to Blackpool so the excitement is off the scale," he said.
"As the dance floor is bigger we have extra dancers so it just feels bigger - and costumes and make-up are always fantastic."
It is hard to speak for a whole town, but in general, Blackpool loves Strictly almost as much as Strictly loves Blackpool.
Visit Blackpool, the town's tourism body, describes the town as "the spiritual home of ballroom dancing" and the show's annual visit as "the most dazzling dance event of the year".
Alongside celebrating the "magnificent" Blackpool Tower Ballroom, it also points visitors to waxwork gallery Madame Tussauds' replica Glitterball trophy and judges' desk.
This includes effigies of judge Craig Revel Horwood and former presenters Tess Daly and Claudia Winkleman.
The entertainment museum Showtown, which has a "dazzling dance gallery which will take you on a journey through Blackpool's history of dance".
Speaking to North West Tonight from the Tower Ballroom, Strictly pro Carlos Gu said he had "been dreaming of coming to Blackpool" since he was a child while Canadian pro Mark Karmalita said he had "goosebumps" when he first stepped into the ballroom.
Fellow pro Lauren Oakley said she had been coming to the seaside resort before she could dance to watch her mum and her cousins compete here.

Sağlıklı uyku süresinin yaşa göre değiştiğini belirten Prof. Dr. Taşkın Duman, yetişkinlerin günde 7 ila 9 saat uyuması gerektiğini söyledi. Yenidoğanlarda uyku süresinin 17 saate kadar çıkabildiğini anlatan Duman, yetişkinler için 7 saatin altındaki uykunun önerilmediğini vurguladı.
İdeal uykunun gece boyunca kesintisiz, sessiz ve uygun sıcaklıktaki bir ortamda gerçekleşmesi gerektiğini ifade etti.
Melatonin hormonuna da değinen Duman, melatoninin doğrudan uyku sağlamadığını, vücudu uykuya hazırladığını anlattı. Dışarıdan alınan melatonin takviyelerinin vücudun doğal üretim ritmini bozabileceği uyarısında bulundu.
Uykunun psikolojik boyutunu değerlendiren Dr. Hicran Tülüce, birçok insanın günlük sorunlarını ve kaygılarını yatağa taşıdığını belirtti.
Geçmişte yaşanan olumsuz olayların ve geleceğe yönelik endişelerin uykuya geçişi zorlaştırabildiğini anlatan Tülüce, yatmadan önce zihni meşgul eden sorunların yazıya dökülmesini ve ertesi güne ertelenmesini önerdi.
İyi uyuma zorunluluğunun da zamanla bir performans baskısına dönüşebildiğini söyledi.
Müzisyen Pınar Aylin ise uyku öncesinde lavanta yağı kullandığını anlattı. Lavantanın kendisinde sakinleştirici ve huzur verici bir etki yarattığını belirten Aylin, doğal yöntemlerden yararlanırken ölçülü davranılması gerektiğini vurguladı.
Uyku apnesinin sağlık üzerindeki etkilerini de değerlendiren Prof. Dr. Taşkın Duman, hastalığın merkezi ve tıkayıcı olmak üzere iki temel türü bulunduğunu söyledi. Merkezi uyku apnesinin beynin solunumu kontrol eden mekanizmalarıyla ilişkili olduğunu belirten Duman, tıkayıcı uyku apnesinde ise fazla kilonun önemli bir risk faktörü olduğunu anlattı.
Uyku sırasında solunumun kesintiye uğrayabildiğini ifade eden Duman, eşlerin birbirlerinin uyku düzenini gözlemlemesinin ve olası solunum problemlerini fark etmesinin önemini vurguladı.

Milliyet'in aktardığına göre Sinan Akçıl , oyuncu Nilsu Berfin Aktaş'ın köpeğinden dünyaya gelen yavrular için sıcak bir yuva ararken Ajda Pekkan'dan yardım istedi. Akçıl, 3 yavru köpekle birlikte ünlü sanatçıyı evinde ziyaret etti.
Pekkan, yavrulardan hiçbirini ayırmadı ve üçünü de evine kabul etti. Minik köpeklerin adları Chanel, Coco ve Jordan olarak belirlendi. Böylece aynı anneden dünyaya gelen 3 kardeş, aynı evde birlikte büyüyecek.
Pekkan'ın hayvanlara ilgisi yeni değil. Sanatçı, Haziran 2025'te Bursa'da Her Eve Pati Derneği'nin (HEPAD) Pati Bahçesi ile Emekli Hayvanlar Çiftliği'ni ziyaret etmiş, koruma altındaki hayvanlarla vakit geçirmişti.
1960'lı yıllarda başlayan müzik kariyeriyle Türk pop müziğinin en tanınan isimleri arasında yer alan Pekkan, "Bambaşka Biri", "Petrol" ve "Yaz Yaz Yaz" gibi şarkılarıyla kuşaklar boyu dinlendi. Sanatçı, bu yılın ağustos ayında 5. İstanbul Festivali kapsamında Yenikapı'da sahne almıştı.
Yavruları Pekkan'a götüren Sinan Akçıl ise şarkıcılığının yanı sıra birçok ünlü isme yazdığı şarkılarla tanınan bir söz yazarı ve besteci.

Netflix'in suç komedisi Big Mistakes dizisinde Yusuf karakterine hayat veren oyuncu Boran Kuzum, ikinci sezon çekimleri sırasında talihsiz bir kaza yaşadı. Çekimlerin son gününde ayağını inciten oyuncu, ameliyat geçirdiğini açıkladı.
Dan Levy imzalı Big Mistakes dizisinin ikinci sezonu için ABD'de bulunan Boran Kuzum, çekimler sırasında yaşadığı kazayla gündeme geldi. Bir davet öncesinde basın mensuplarının sorularını yanıtlayan oyuncu, olayın çekimlerin son sahnesinde meydana geldiğini belirterek, "Küçük bir set kazası. Son sahnede ayağım döndü." dedi.

Yaşadığı kaza nedeniyle 37. Ankara Film Festivali Onur Ödülleri Töreni'nde bulunamayan oyuncu, kendisine verilen Vakıf Özel Ödülü için bir video mesaj gönderdi.
Kuzum, çekimlerin son gününde yaşadığı kaza nedeniyle ameliyata gireceğini ve törene katılamadığı için üzgün olduğunu mesajında dile getirdi. Bu video, oyuncunun yaşadığı kazayla ilgili kamuoyuna yaptığı ilk açıklama olarak aktarıldı.
Ameliyatın ardından İstanbul'un Etiler semtinde basın mensuplarının karşısına çıkan Boran Kuzum'un genel durumunun iyi olduğu görüldü. Oyuncu, sağlık durumuyla ilgili ayrıntılı bilgi paylaşmadı.

Touché tells the story of Deep who seeks to change her life by taking up fencing
It was Hollywood more than Bollywood that British Indian filmmaker Parvinder Shergill grew up on, with Karate Kid, Rocky, A Few Good Men and ET among her favourite films.
The actor, writer and producer, who lives in Berkshire, says she feels "really lucky" that she comes from "two worlds".
Shergill says she builds stories around both cultures, the latest of which are her new film Touché and her first play Threads of Healing.
As she talks about wanting to "inspire" with her work, she says "it's an exciting time to embrace who you are, whatever that means to you".
Shergill says a lot of the work she consumed growing up was "very male-driven, global, mainstream, commercial".
But even though she wants to make work for the Western audience, she says her perspective "has an added layer of always having a female South Asian protagonist".
"I'm also going to be doing a sci-fi next year, there happens to be a brown woman in it, but it's not about her being brown. It's just she's in the sci-fi world."
She says she considers having a perspective from two cultures "a blessing".
"My sister does polo, I've done fencing and chess but we're British Indian women in a sari - that's wicked."
Parvinder Shergill says she "couldn't believe" the cast she assembled, including comedian Paul Chowdhry
Shergill says the world of Bollywood world as "very visual, it's very culture rich, it's very high on emotions".
In contrast she says "especially [in] Britain, our work is very deep thinking, it's very articulate, it's very heavy on the words".
She says she has projects in the pipeline that will "honour both worlds in a global audience".
"I think there is a way to combine great emotion and visual storytelling the way Bollywood does, especially with the soundtracks, but with excellent writing and what British playwrights and screenwriters have to offer."
Her approach is through subtlety, such as making sure the accents of her characters reflect the area they are from.
"Instead of drinking tea she might drink chai or instead of wearing a simple studded earring it might be a beautiful intricate Indian earring.
Threads of Healing is Shergill's first play, starring Parminder Nagra and Dame Meera Syal
Shergill, who is also an NHS psychiatrist, says exploring mental health "will always be in all of my work".
Her play for BBC Radio 4 Drama , also available in print, explores personal trauma and overcoming it - a topic which she says is "really stigmatised still" in the South Asian community.
"It's a very difficult conversation and it's something I really try to look at."
She says trauma in all its forms is something that especially women in the community do not come forward with because they fear the consequences.
Bend It Like Beckham star Parminder Nagra plays the lead in Threads of Healing, which Shergill describes as "such a 360 moment".
"And Meera Syal, who plays her mother, I thought, 'we really look up to them in the community, hopefully people will listen and it will come more of a conversation piece'," she added.
Dame Meera has spoken openly about having been sexually harassed and assaulted.
Even though Shergill wants to make work for the Western audience, she says her perspective "has an added layer of always having a female South Asian protagonist"
On Touché, which will be screened in cinemas from 27 November, Shergill says she has "a soft place".
The film tells the story of a British South Asian woman named Deep, played by Shergill, who seeks to change her life by taking up fencing.
The actress had fenced in school and at university and describes it as "a mix of chess with pilates and yoga and weights".
"We were meant to get stunts and cranes and a stunt double but the ironic thing is, I could not find a stunt double who looked like me.
"That was just wild to me, so I thought, 'right, this is another reason to make the film'."
She says she "couldn't believe the cast we got", including Harry Potter star Matthew Lewis, comedian Paul Chowdhry and writer and actor Stephen Fry.
Shergill says there is also "an underlying mental storyline that I've dedicated the film to my grandfather who passed this year for that".
Shergill considers having a perspective from two cultures "a blessing"
Of her own role she says it was inspired by the theme of the underdog who becomes a hero "but it happens to not be a boy [but] someone that looks like me and other women".
"I really wanted to make something where girls can look at and be like, 'you know what? I can be a good person despite what happens in life if I just try really hard', so I wanted it to be an inspiring story," she says.
The film won the Tongues on Fire Flame Award at the 28th UK Asian Film Festival and Shergill says she is now "really excited" for her "first ever theatrical release".
"We actually had a little South Asian boy who's now fencing, which is so cool, so you don't know how you can inspire people."

Morfydd Clark plays the elf Galadriel, portrayed by Cate Blanchett in Peter Jackson's Lord of the Rings film trilogy
Actress Morfydd Clark has described how filming The Rings of Power allowed her to see "all these secret bits" of Wales she had not visited before.
The fantasy adventure is set thousands of years before the events of JRR Tolkien's The Hobbit and Lord of the Rings in the fictional Middle Earth.
Clark, who is from Penarth, Vale of Glamorgan, was able to see parts of her own country she had not explored before while filming the third series of the Amazon Prime Video programme.
The star is reprising her leading role as the fierce elf commander Galadriel - and has also admitted how she slipped some Welsh words into her role.
Clark said her mother used to wait for the credits to see the interesting places where programmes had been shot.
It is reported The Rings of Power was filmed at Neath Abbey and Trefil Quarry, Blaenau Gwent, among other places.
Last autumn, the cast was also spotted in Devon , shooting along the coast.
"Look at the credits," Clark said, urging fans to do the same as her mum to find out where it was filmed.
It is not only the scenery that may be familiar to people from Wales, but Tolkien's invented Elvish language has been described as having Celtic influences .
Clark, a fluent Welsh speaker, admitted slipping some words in, including the command "cer" to her horse – the Welsh word for "go".
During series one, Galadriel was seen shouting the command "cer" to her horse, the Welsh word for "go"
The actress, who has also starred in Dracula and His Dark Materials, warned fans that all is not well for the protagonists in the upcoming series, joking: "It's going terribly."
Referring to the evil sorcerer who is trying to take over the fictional Middle Earth, Clark said: "Sauron is back and powerful and evil.
Series three is set five years after the events of series two, and hope is dim in Middle Earth as Sauron's armies have conquered almost all in their path.
A few pockets of resistance remain, including Galadriel and her fellow elves, but Sauron works day and night to harness the power of the One Ring to crush them.
In the series, the "sorcerer of dreadful power" Sauron is played by Charlie Vickers, who starred in Netflix historical drama Medici
Despite this, Clark says the series will also look back on Galadriel's happier days, where the audience will see the serious commander dance and be cheerful.
Clark enjoyed the chance to "go back in time" and explore this new side of her character, adding: "It felt really exciting to go and find a different part of who she was."
In Jackson's Lord of the Rings film trilogy, Galadriel is serene and wise yet immensely powerful.
Meanwhile, the Prime Video prequel depicts the character in her youth, wilful and rebellious.
"It's wonderful to play someone brave and unapologetic, and also not afraid of social consequences," Clark said.
"I like to try and push myself to be a bit more like her at times."
Clark is joined in series three by Stranger Things actor Jamie Campbell Bower, who plays Galadriel's long-lost husband Celeborn
The Lord of the Rings franchise is globally beloved, so taking on such a recognised role as Galadriel comes with a lot of pressure, believes Clark.
However, given that an actor's job is to "make a career out of emotions", she feels a similar responsibility in all her acting pursuits.
"I've just resigned myself to the fact the neurosis will always be there, whether I'm doing a speech at Christmas or filming this," she said.
Series three of Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power is available to watch now.

Pınar Aylin 54 yaşında. 19 Kasım'da kızı Maya Tokatlıoğlu ile katıldığı bir film galasında objektiflere poz verdi; oyuncu kızıyla yan yana çekilen fotoğrafları, 90'ların bu tanıdık yüzünü yeniden aranan isimler arasına soktu.
Pınar Aylin 54 yaşında. Tam adı Fatma Pınar Aylin olan şarkıcı 12 Mayıs 1972'de doğdu.
Pınar Aylin, 1990'ların ikinci yarısında pop listelerine giren bir şarkıcı. Müzik kariyerine 1994'te İstanbul 'da başladı, ilk albümü "Ben Bahara Hazırım" 1995'te Raks Müzik etiketiyle çıktı. Bu albümden "Deliler Gibi", "Ya Sen Gidip De", "Karar Ver" ve "Körkütük" için klip çekildi.
Sonraki yıllarda "Güneşten" (1997), "Ay Işığında" (1998), "Çöl Fırtınası" (2000), "No. 5" (2004), "Aslolan Ben" (2007) ve "Masal Bu Ya" (2009) albümlerini yayımladı. 2011'de 70'lerin şarkılarını yorumladığı "Hit 70'ler" geldi. 2009'da "Bez Bebek" dizisinde oyunculuk da yaptı, 2017'de "Peri Masalı" adlı bir roman yazdı. Son çalışmaları 2019'da çıkan "Aradığın Aşk Bende" ve "Yazık Oldu" adlı tekliler.
Pınar Aylin'in en bilinen şarkısı "Deliler Gibi". 1997'deki "Güneşten" albümünden "Yalvaramam", "Adam Olaydın" ve "Arama", 1998'den "Bekletme" ve "Dokun Bana" da onun şarkıları. "Bekletme"nin İngilizce versiyonu "Don't Make Me Wait"i Michael Damian ile söyledi.
Pınar Aylin İzmir 'de yaşıyor. 2012'de İstanbul 'dan İzmir 'e taşındı. Mayıs 2026'da kısa bir ziyaret için geldiği İstanbul 'da "15 senedir İzmir 'deyiz" dedi ve zeytin ağaçlarının arasında yaşadıklarını anlattı. Aynı sohbette yapay zekâyla yapılan müziğe karşı olduğunu, kendisinin yapay zekâ kullanmamakta direndiğini söyledi.
Pınar Aylin liseyi İzmir Özel Türk Koleji'nde okudu, ardından Ege Üniversitesi İletişim Fakültesi'nde Halkla İlişkiler ve Reklamcılık Bölümü'ne girdi.
Pınar Aylin'in kızı Maya Tokatlıoğlu, şarkıcının iş insanı Mert Tokatlıoğlu ile evliliğinden 2002'de doğdu. Çift 2008'de boşandı. Maya, İzmir Amerikan Koleji'nin ardından İstanbul Bilgi Üniversitesi Yeni Medya ve İletişim Bölümü'nü bitirdi ve oyunculuk yapıyor. "Sadece Bir An" filmiyle kameranın karşısına geçti, "İmam Gazali" dizisinde ve "Damat Mektebi" filminde oynadı.

Manchester City are living in Premier League purgatory, without a win in four but at least ended their three-game losing run against Fulham. As they await the fate of their much-publicised appeal after being found guilty of financial breaches, their form has slumped as further evidenced by a passive draw.
Arguments will be made over Erling Haaland’s disallowed goal but City did not deserve anything more. The Norwegian uncharacteristically missed a number of fine chances as Rodrigo Muniz took advantage of City’s porous defence, who had to rely on Elliot Anderson to get anything out of the fixture.
City approached the game with the same subdued nature of the crowd, as is customary for a Saturday lunchtime kick-off. For a team amid a poor run of domestic form , they offered little in the way of dynamism from the off. A couple of harsh chances were brushed off by Fulham, who were allowed to ease themselves into the game.
Confusion between defence and midfield has repeatedly caused problems for City under Enzo Maresca, who witnessed Marc Guéhi going over the halfway to press a throw-in deep inside the Fulham half. When the visitors won the first head, the centre-back was out of position and everything was far too simple from then on. The former City winger Oscar Bobb shimmied and Muniz curled into the top corner from the edge of the box, before an emotional celebration in honour of his pregnant wife, who previously suffered a miscarriage.
It was a day where the team needed to inspire the crowd and City finally discovered intent midway through the first-half. Iliman Ndiaye’s dangerous cross found Haaland at the back post but he could not finish at the first time of asking, allowing Bernd Leno to get his hands to the ball but whether the German had it under control is another matter. Haaland jabbed at the goalkeeper, nudging the ball through his grasp but the referee signalled fouled and no one with access to replays disagreed. No one connected to City felt it was a correct decision, with Thomas Bramall offering the benefit of the doubt to Leno.
City lacked a cutting edge; Phil Foden, given the nod over Rayan Cherki at No 10, had chances to feed Haaland in good positions but twice the execution of the pass ensured there was no change. At the third time of asking, the pair connected, only for Haaland to balloon at shot from close range, and under little pressure, into the stands. Every Haaland finish was a whimsical version of what everyone expects, miscuing a straightforward chance from a Nico O’Reilly cross, too. It felt like one of those days.
City continued to find it difficult as David Affengruber and Calvin Bassey put in fine performances at centre-back, reading every strand of danger and snuffing it out. To find a way back into the match, City needed to increase the tempo and find the absent aggressive, something Anderson obliged by violently volleying a cleared corner into the bottom corner from 18 yards.
Anderson is becoming Maresca’s most trusted player, preferred to Enzo Fernández to provide the thrust alongside Ayyoub Bouaddi. In a team lacking energy, the England international is a catalyst in what is a difficult period for an underperforming team. He latched onto a Haaland flick-on in each of a second but could not stay on his feet. The pair combined for a second time but Anderson’s quick feet and cute finish concluded with the ball slipping an inch wide.
With the tide turning, City’s flaws were there for all to see as Fulham won the ball and within a blink of an eye Muniz was through on goal thanks to the lack of resistance in blue. Gianluigi Donnarumma was the last – and sturdiest – line of defence, repeating the feat against Bassey soon after. These were the best chances of the second half, as City were unable to create a meaningful chance on another worrying afternoon, which concluded with further jeers.

Elon Musk’s lawyer is joining Tom Brady in buying a stake in Chelsea. The Guardian revealed on Friday that the NFL player is in discussions about purchasing a minority shareholding at Stamford Bridge and can now disclose that Alex Spiro of the New York law firm Quinn Emmanuel is also seeking to buy a stake by investing in Chelsea’s majority owners, Clearlake Capital.
Brady and Spiro, who is representing planned Fifa investor Joshua Kushner in a legal battle against Uefa, would become limited partners in Clearlake with no voting rights at Chelsea if the transactions are completed.
Clearlake have been seeking additional investors since agreeing to buy the shares of former partners Todd Boehly and Mark Walter for around £1bn in September, a deal that is due to be completed by the end of the year.
Clearlake will own 86.5% of Chelsea after buying out Boehly and Walter, who both held stakes of 12.9%, with the proposed investments of Brady and Spiro understood to be considerably smaller. As part of that transaction Boehly and Walter’s partner, the Swiss philanthropist Hansjorg Wyss, chose to stay at Chelsea by buying 12.9% of Clearlake’s shareholding.
Any other future investors such as Brady and Spiro would follow the same model.
Spiro has represented Musk since 2018 and advised on his $44bn (£33.6bn) purchase of Twitter (now X) in 2022, as well as working for other celebrity clients, including Alec Baldwin, Kim Kardashian and Jay-Z.
In 2019 he successfully defended Musk in a notorious defamation trial relating to comments he made about the rescuer of junior football players from a Thailand cave, while in 2024 his defence helped Baldwin’s acquittal on charges involuntary manslaughter after a cinematographer died on the set of his film Rust, when a prop revolver discharged a live round.
Last summer Spiro was also appointed to represent Kushner, whose company Thrive Capital were the lead investors in Gianni Infantino’s $4.2bn World Cup sell-off scheme, in a legal challenge from Uefa .
Kushner, the brother of Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared, is facing court claims in the United States from Uefa’s lawyers to disclose all communications relating to Infantino’s Fifa Forward Enterprise plan . Last week a New York court rejected a motion by two Fifa subsidiaries to dismiss Uefa’s claim, but the courts have yet to rule on the disclosure filing.
Brady owned a 3.3% stake in Championship club Birmingham City until earlier this month, with sources involved in his decision to sell those shares telling the Guardian that he was paving the way to invest in Chelsea.
The seven-time Super Bowl winner was a guest of Chelsea when they won the Club World Cup in New Jersey last year, and has a good relationship with the Clearlake’s main power broker, Behdad Eghbali, who has led discussions on behalf of the club.
Brady bought into Birmingham in August 2023, less than a year after his second and final retirement from the NFL, following the club’s takeover by Tom Wagner’s Knighthead Capital.
The 49-year-old was appointed chair of the club’s advisory board and had a prominent role in the 2025 Amazon Prime documentary Built in Birmingham: Brady & The Blues, which made headlines when he questioned the “work ethic” of Wayne Rooney, who was the manager. Brady also owns a minority stake in the NFL team the Las Vegas Raiders, which he bought alongside Wagner.

Report and free match highlights from the Sky Bet Championship match between Norwich City and Cardiff City at Carrow Road on Saturday; Paris Maghoma and Mathias Kvistgaarden net as Canaries secure comeback win.
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
Norwich came from behind to beat Cardiff 2-1 and make it five straight Championship victories - after losing their previous five.
The Canaries went behind just after the break when Yousef Salech got on the end of a free-kick from deep but the visitors were quickly back on level terms as Paris Maghoma scored for the fourth game running.
And it did not take them long to score what proved to be the winner, with Mathias Kvistgaarden tapping home on 68 minutes after his penalty had been kept out by Nathan Trott.
Cardiff performed gamely all afternoon but were unable to get the equaliser their gutsy performance probably deserved.
Both sides knocked the ball around neatly in an evenly-contested first half, with the visitors creating the better chances.
With just three minutes on the clock home keeper Dan Grimshaw did well to tip a beautifully-struck Rubin Colwill free-kick over while the Cardiff skipper went even closer midway through the half. This time a move that ran the length of the pitch ended with the big midfielder clipping the crossbar with an effort from just outside the 'D'.
Norwich launched plenty of promising attacks of their own, but they generally lacked any penetration and Andre Brooks' close-range effort into the side netting on 25 minutes was the closest they came to breaking the deadlock in the opening period.
Southampton 2-0 Derby: Cyle Larin and Divin Mubama strike in Saints win
Millwall 0-1 Queens Park Rangers: Nicolas Madsen nets as QPR see off 10-man Lions
Birmingham 2-1 Swansea: Jay Stansfield scores twice as Blues go top of the Championship
Cardiff 5-4 Burnley: Bluebirds hit back from 4-1 down to claim astonishing comeback win
Watford 0-0 Middlesbrough: Kim Hellberg's Boro knocked off top after goalless draw
Preston 1-0 Southampton: Jordan Thompson steers North End to victory
Cardiff took a little over two minutes to get their noses in front after the break as Alex Robertson's inswinging free-kick to the back post was missed by home defence and Salech was on hand to stroke the ball into the bottom corner for his ninth goal of the season.
Norwich responded well and should have been back on level terms on the hour mark when Anthony Musuba bore down on goal from the left only to screw his shot horribly wide.
But the home faithful did not have to wait long for an equaliser. On 62 minutes the visitors unwisely left Maghoma with some space on the edge of the area and the in-form midfielder curled a delightful shot beyond the reach of Trott and into the far corner.
The momentum was now very much with the Canaries and they completed a swift turnaround by going ahead from the spot in the 68th minute. Ronan Kpakio was penalised for bring down Brooks as he made his way to the byline and although Trott saved Kvistgaarden's penalty, the Danish striker had no problem converting the rebound to make it 2-1.
Salech had a header rightly ruled out for offside as Cardiff sought a response while at the other end substitutes Lucien Mahovo and Jovon Makama were both inches away from stretching Norwich's lead.
Cardiff top scorer Jack Moylan was foiled by a good stop from Grimshaw late on as the home side notched up another win.

Ukrayna Ligi'nde sezonun 13. hafta maçında Arda Turan yönetimindeki Shakhtar Donetsk, evinde Livyi Bereh ile karşı karşıya geldi. Rakibiyle 1-1 berabere kalan Shakhtar sürpriz bir puan kaybı yaşadı.
Livyi Bereh, 19. dakikada Nazarii Vorobchak'la öne geçti. İlk devre konuk takımın üstünlüğüyle tamamlanırken Shakhtar Donetsk beraberlik golünü 61'de Alisson Santana ile buldu. Karşılaşmanın kalan dakikalarında skor değişmedi ve 90 dakika 1-1'lik beraberlik sonuçlandı.
Ligde ilk sırada yer alan Shahktar Donetsk 30, 11. basamaktaki Livyi Bereh ise 10 puana yükseldi. Karşılaşmanın ardından Shakhtar Donetsk Teknik Direktörü Arda Turan açıklamalarda bulundu.
Arda Turan takımın performansını eleştirirken şunları söyledi:
"İlk yarıdan sonra 10 oyuncunun tamamını değiştiremediğim için dört oyuncu değiştirdim. Şimdi tam olarak neyin yanlış gittiğini ve hazırlıkta nerede hata yaptığımı bulmam gerekiyor. Bugünkü maçın, bir buçuk yıldır antrenman yaptığımız ve bu sayede olumlu sonuçlar ve zaferler elde ettiğimiz oyun tarzından çok uzak olduğunu vurgulayabilirim. Bağlamı dikkate almalısınız. Çok fazla süre alamayan futbolcu vardı, bu yüzden muhtemelen konsantrasyon eksikliği yaşadılar ve bu da oyun standartlarımıza uymalarını engelledi. Rakip sahanın son yaratıcılıktan uzak kaldık ve çok aceleci kararlar aldık. Çok üzgünüz ve şimdi zorlu ve önemli bir işimiz var."
“Bu karşılaşmayı bana bir buçuk yıl önce sorsaydınız, çok daha olumlu olurdum, ama şimdi gerçekler değişti. Bir ay önce bile daha iyi olduğumuzu söylerdim ama şimdi Fenerbahçe'nin yeni bir teknik direktörü var, onun liderliğinde çok iyi başladılar ve ilerlemeye devam ediyorlar. Favori Fenerbahçe."
"Bugün sahada bir sürü başarısız karar varsa, öncelikle herkesin kendini sorgulaması gerektiğini vurgulamak isterim. Kulüp, kendimiz ve federasyon olarak Ukrayna için tarihi bir deneyim kazanma fırsatımız var. Elbette zor olacak ve bir anlamda sahada acı çekmek zorunda kalacağız ancak bu yolculuk boyunca bizi başarıya götüren önemli özellikleri hatırlamalıyız.”
Maça ilişkin ayrıca Arda Turan, " Futbolda duygusuz taktiklerin değersiz olduğunu hatırlamalıyız. Shakhtar, kendi sahasında bugünkü maçta olduğu gibi oynayamaz. Buna asla izin vermeyeceğim. Eğer oyuncular doğru bir şekilde oynamak için konsantrasyon eksikliği yaşadıysa, bu öncelikle benim hatamdır. Bunun sorumluluğunu alacağım ve ne yapabileceğimi anlamak için olabildiğince analiz yapacağım " değerlendirmesinde bulundu.
